candidate_c.safe_fit_bound: For a certified strict-UTF-8 block, its UTF-8 byte length is an upper bound on its ordinary token count. If exact sealed-prefix tokens plus this bound fit, preserve that first-fit acceptance without an immediate encode. candidate_c.token_boundary_hypothesis: Every actual citation block begins with '[' and accepted blocks are joined by exactly two LF characters. For the two exact registered tokenizer regexes, no pretokenizer alternative consumes the terminal LF and then '['. At the left segment's end, cl100k's end-of-string whitespace alternative consumes the same whole trailing whitespace as its newline alternative because the segment ends with LF. Therefore the sealed previous block plus separator and the next citation block are separate BPE pieces; their token-ID concatenation, and thus counts, are exact. This is a certified specific boundary, not arbitrary token-count additivity.

bounded_highlight_read.hypothesis: SQLite EXPLAIN on an invented schema shows MATCH plus rowid IN repeats the virtual scan per rowid, while MATCH plus a rowid range and unary-plus whitelist uses one bounded scan.
bounded_highlight_read.rule: Only when at least two selected truncated rowids lie within a span of at most 256, add the exact redundant minimum/maximum bounds and apply the identical whitelist through +rowid IN. Single-id and wide-span requests keep the historical query. Highlighted bodies and keyed results must match exactly.
